regs.name: Building regulations
regs.hint: Tick the packs to list in the Regulations panel; drawings that have no ticks of their own are checked against them. Packs come from the regions you picked in Settings › Global › Building regulations, grouped by place. A pack holds numbers and clause numbers, never the standard's text. A guide only: the registered professional and the local authority decide.
regs.unavailable: The regulation packs could not be read. The stair tools keep their built-in limits.
regs.state.unchecked: Not checked: these numbers have not been confirmed against the standard.
regs.state.draft: Draft: entered from the published code, not yet reviewed by a professional.
regs.sch.title: Building regulations
regs.sch.note: Checked against {pack}. {state} Window areas are opening sizes, not glass; how much opens is estimated from the window type. Wall height is the lowest wall on the level. A guide only: the registered professional and the local authority decide.
regs.st.ok: Meets {pack}: {list}. A guide only: the building official decides.
regs.st.bad: Outside {pack}: {list}. A guide only: the building official decides.
regs.st.none: {pack} has no stair rules to check this stair against.
regs.p.none: {label} ({need}) could not be worked out for {where}, so it is not checked there.
regs.none: No pack is ticked, so nothing is checked and the stair tools keep their built-in limits.
regs.mode.each: Check each pack on its own and report each
regs.mode.strict: Use the strictest limit of the ticked packs
regs.mode.chain: A state, county or city pack overrides the pack it builds on
regs.state.own: Your pack: uploaded on this computer. Nobody has reviewed it.
regs.up.title: Upload a regulations file
regs.up.hint: Add a pack of your own (a regulation pack file, .json). It is kept on this computer only and listed as Your pack under its country.
regs.up.big: This file is too big to be a regulation pack.
regs.up.json: This file is not a regulation pack: it could not be read as JSON.
regs.up.removed: The pack was removed from this computer.
regs.noregions: No region is installed. Pick the countries you work in under Settings › Global › Building regulations.
regs.rg.hint: Tick the countries you work in. Their regulation packs come from the CadCraft Library and are kept on this computer for every app, so checks work offline. Open a country to see its packs.
regs.rg.none: The Library has no regulation packs yet.
regs.rg.offline: The Library could not be reached. The regions already installed keep working.
regs.rg.done: Installed {name}: {packs}. They are listed in each app's Building regulations settings.
regs.rg.checking: Checking the Library for newer packs…
regs.p.title: Regulations
regs.p.nomodel: Open or start a model: ticks here are saved in the drawing.
regs.p.saved: These ticks are saved in this drawing.
regs.p.defaultsused: This drawing has no ticks of its own yet: your defaults from Settings apply. Change a tick to save them in the drawing.
regs.p.empty: No pack is listed. Pick regions in Settings › Global and packs in Settings › BimCraft.
regs.sheet.title: Code summary
regs.sheet.meta: Drawing: {file}. Made {date} by the Building regulations add-on in BimCraft.
regs.sheet.legal: A guide to help prepare the permit set, not a code review or legal advice. The registered professional and the building department decide; a check passes only for what the drawing shows.
regs.sheet.notset: not in the pack: ask the building department
regs.sheet.sum: {meets} met, {fails} not met, {none} could not be worked out.
regs.sheet.nodraw: Switch on Draw so the drawing is checked, then make the sheet again.
regs.f.label: Filter the packs
regs.f.ph: Filter by place, pack, rule or clause (Colorado, header, R403)
regs.f.none: No pack or rule matches the filter.
regs.rules.some: Rules in this pack: {n} of {all} shown
regs.p.upd: A newer version of {pack} is installed (v{now}). This drawing was checked against v{was}.
